name: Simple Checkout for Italy Lite
author: Apollo Siti Web

sections.description:
Simple Checkout for Italy Lite is the free solution to adapt your WooCommerce checkout to the regulations and habits of the Italian market.

With this plugin, you can:
* Add Mandatory Tax Fields: Allow customers to choose whether they are purchasing as an “Individual” or a “Company”. The plugin will dynamically display the correct fields: “Codice Fiscale” (Tax Code) for individuals, and “Partita IVA” (VAT Number), “Codice Destinatario (SDI)”, and “PEC” (Certified Email) for companies.
* Increase Trust: Display customizable trust badges in the cart and at checkout to reassure your customers about payment security.
* Optimize Conversions: Activate the “Skip Cart” feature to redirect users directly to the payment page after adding a product, reducing cart abandonment.

This plugin is the “Lite” version of the more powerful Simple Checkout for Italy PRO and gives you a taste of its potential to improve conversions.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the checkout-italia-semplice-lite folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Checkout Italia Lite to configure the settings.
sections.faq:
The fields for Individual/Company are not appearing. Why?

Make sure your theme uses the standard WooCommerce hooks (woocommerce_before_checkout_billing_form). If you have a block theme, try using the troubleshooter tool on the plugin’s settings page to create a standard checkout page.

Can I customize the trust badges?

Of course. From the settings page, you can choose which badges to display (PayPal, Stripe, Credit Cards, etc.) and customize the section title.

Is this plugin compatible with…?

The plugin is designed to work with most themes and plugins that follow WooCommerce standards.
